quotes.text: Rest now; tomorrow's strength is built in tonight's sleep.
Let the stars keep watch while you let go of the day.
Good night! Close your eyes on worry and open them to hope.
The moon shines brightest in the darkest sky.
Every night is a soft reset for the heart and mind.
Sleep peacefully; you did enough today.
Dreams are tomorrow's plans, whispered in the dark.
Turn off the noise, turn on the calm, and rest well.
